messages:
sam: Heads-up 1  Zephyr Bio agreed to a profile interview. Slot booked Tue 4/20 2:00pm PT. We need legal approval for the quote, confirmation of the performance numbers, recording owner, and lead routing for post-publish demo invites. Calendly link: <https://calendly.example/zephyr-interview>

violet: I can take recording + deliverables. Prefer Zoom cloud + local audio. Will schedule a 15-min tech check at 1:40pm.

tom: Draft quote for review (please edit):
```
\"With Redwood Dedicated we reduced inference cost per request by ~58% and cut 95th percentile latency by 50%, enabling Zephyr to ship faster.\"
```

rafa: CS/ops: I need to validate the ~58% and 50% numbers with the infra team. If it's estimated we should prefix with ~. Will confirm by Mon EOD.

ines: Design needs: hi-res headshots (400x400 min), transparent logo (svg/png), and any brand guidelines. Need assets by Tue noon to make thumbnails and a 30s social cut.

dara: Legal: if we publish exact figures we require signed customer approval. Also avoid any clinical or sensitive claims. Send final quote and attestation here and I'll review.

sam: Who's owner for pull quotes and the blog draft?

violet: I'll handle the transcript and pull quotes. Tom can draft the blog and webinar blurb.

tom: Will draft blog + 2-line webinar teaser once numbers are final. Proposed blurb draft: "See how Zephyr Bio reduced inference cost and improved latency to move from prototype to production." Thoughts?

dara: Blurb ok but remove any wording implying clinical results. Keep it product/infra focused.

rafa: Ops confirms numbers by Mon 4/19 5pm. I'll post signed confirmation here.

violet: Recording checklist: 1) Gallery + shared screen recording if they demo; 2) Local audio backup; 3) Otter.ai transcript; 4) Save raw + trimmed to /marketing/assets/zephyr/raw/; 5) capture slides as PDF.

ines: I'll create thumbnail comps and a 30s paid social edit; need final quote + headshots by Tue noon.

sam: Lead routing: SDR ops wants demo signups to go to campaign=zephyr_q2 and queue west-sdr. Also want tracking UTMs. Can marketing ops spin up slug /demo/zephyr-q2?

tom: I'll add utm_campaign=zephyr_q2 to the blog links and coordinate landing slug with ops.

dara: Once CS posts the customer attestation and numbers I'll perform a legal review and post approval.

rafa: Confirmed 1 numbers verified with infra. I'll attach the signed attestation by Mon 5pm.

sam: Timeline summary:
- Mon 5pm: CS/ops signed numbers + attestation
- Tue noon: design assets in folder
- Tue 1:40pm: tech check
- Tue 2:00pm: recording
- Fri: publish blog + social + webinar mention + route leads

sam: Thanks team 1 I'll post the rehearsal invite in #launches and create the launch checklist here. :rocket:
